sentences.en: It is Thanksgiving, and we are taking the week off, but we wanted to highlight an original Odyssey podcast, and we're going to feature it today.
sentences.zh: 正值感恩节，我们这周休息，但我们想重点推荐一档 Odyssey 原创播客，并将在今天播出。

sentences.en: Yes, it is called Gone South, and it is an award-winning true crime documentary podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 没错，它叫《南方往事》（Gone South），是一档屡获殊荣的真实犯罪纪录片播客。

sentences.en: Season four is out now, and it tells a different story about one of the South's most interesting crimes.
sentences.zh: 第四季现已上线，讲述了南方最引人入胜的犯罪故事之一。

sentences.en: You can tune in every week as writer and host Jed Lipinski takes you through one of these crimes.
sentences.zh: 您可以每周收听，跟随编导兼主持人 Jed Lipinski 一起深入了解这些案件。

sentences.en: You will hear from the person who committed the crime, the person who solved it, or both.
sentences.zh: 您将听到犯罪者本人、案件侦破者，或者双方的讲述。

sentences.en: Gone South not only sheds fascinating insights into the criminal mind, but also into human nature.
sentences.zh: 《南方往事》不仅能带您深入洞察犯罪心理，还能让您对人性有更深的理解。

sentences.en: If you ever have a chance to visit the Louisiana State Penitentiary, and I hope you don't, you'll notice something unusual on the way in.
sentences.zh: 如果你有机会去路易斯安那州立监狱参观——我希望你不会去——你会发现在入口处有些不同寻常的东西。

sentences.en: Right outside the front entrance, there's a gift shop, a prison gift shop.
sentences.zh: 就在正门外，有一家礼品店，一家监狱礼品店。

sentences.en: They sell various trinkets and posters, and you could even walk away with a t-shirt.
sentences.zh: 他们出售各种小饰品和海报，你甚至可以买件T恤带走。

sentences.en: A t-shirt with a picture of the prison entrance, and a caption underneath that reads,
sentences.zh: 一件印有监狱入口照片的T恤，下面写着一行字：

sentences.en: Louisiana State Penitentiary sits on 18,000 acres, just south of the Mississippi border.
sentences.zh: 路易斯安那州立监狱占地 18,000 英亩，位于密西西比州边境以南。

sentences.en: The prison is better known as Angola, because the land it occupies used to be a slave plantation,
sentences.zh: 这座监狱更广为人知的名字是“安哥拉”（Angola），因为这片土地曾经是一个奴隶种植园，

sentences.en: and a majority of the people enslaved there were taken from the West African country of Angola.
sentences.zh: 而那里的大多数奴隶都是从西非国家安哥拉被掳掠来的。

sentences.en: The plantation became a prison in 1880, but an outside observer would have noticed almost no change.
sentences.zh: 该种植园在 1880 年变成了监狱，但外人几乎看不出有什么变化。

sentences.en: Inmates lived in former slave quarters.
sentences.zh: 囚犯们住在以前的奴隶宿舍里。

sentences.en: They worked the fields, just as slaves had.
sentences.zh: 他们像奴隶一样在田间劳作。

sentences.en: They lived short and brutal lives.
sentences.zh: 他们的生命短暂而残酷。

sentences.en: Conditions hardly improved in the 20th century.
sentences.zh: 到了 20 世纪，条件几乎没有改善。

sentences.en: After a plague of murders, stabbings, and sexual assaults got the attention of the press in the 1960s,
sentences.zh: 在 20 世纪 60 年代，一系列谋杀、刺伤和性侵事件引起了媒体的关注，

sentences.en: Angola was named the bloodiest prison in America.
sentences.zh: 安哥拉监狱被冠以“美国最血腥监狱”的称号。

sentences.en: And it was almost impossible to escape.
sentences.zh: 而且，这里几乎不可能逃脱。

sentences.en: Angola is surrounded on three sides by the Mississippi River.
sentences.zh: 安哥拉监狱的三面被密西西比河环绕。

sentences.en: It's hemmed in on the other by dense, snake-infested swampland.
sentences.zh: 另一面则被茂密、毒蛇出没的沼泽地所阻隔。

sentences.en: Guards patrol the grounds on horseback, armed with 12-gauge shotguns.
sentences.zh: 狱警骑着马在场内巡逻，配备 12 号口径霰弹枪。

sentences.en: Multiple outbuildings, barriers, and sniper towers are designed to prevent escapes.
sentences.zh: 众多的附属建筑、障碍物和狙击塔都是为了防止越狱而设计的。

sentences.en: Even if an inmate did escape, they often drowned in the Mississippi's rushing currents,
sentences.zh: 即使囚犯真的逃了出去，他们也往往会淹死在密西西比河湍急的河流中，

sentences.en: or succumbed to exposure, or got bitten by a rattlesnake.
sentences.zh: 或者死于恶劣天气，又或者被响尾蛇咬伤。

sentences.en: And according to those who tried, a failed escape could be a fate worse than death.
sentences.zh: 据那些尝试过的人说，越狱失败的下场可能比死还惨。

sentences.en: The punishment for escaping included months, if not years, in solitary,
sentences.zh: 越狱的惩罚包括数月甚至数年的单独监禁，

sentences.en: or what inmates called the dungeon.
sentences.zh: 也就是囚犯们所说的“地牢”。

sentences.en: Conditions one visitor in the 1970s described as medieval.
sentences.zh: 一位 20 世纪 70 年代的访客形容那里的条件简直是中世纪式的。

sentences.en: And yet, in the 1980s, one inmate successfully escaped from Angola not once, but twice.
sentences.zh: 然而，在 20 世纪 80 年代，有一名囚犯成功地从安哥拉监狱越狱，而且不是一次，是两次。

sentences.en: I don't know if you can even fathom it,
sentences.zh: 我不知道你能不能想象，

sentences.en: but it's a big thrill when you successfully escape incarceration.
sentences.zh: 但当你成功越狱时，那种快感是巨大的。

sentences.en: Better feeling than any narcotic I ever had.
sentences.zh: 比我用过的任何毒品感觉都要好。

sentences.en: From Odyssey Podcasts, this is Gone South.
sentences.zh: 这里是 Odyssey 播客出品的《南方往事》。

sentences.en: In this episode, I'm going to tell you the story of Jimmy Cox.
sentences.zh: 在这一集中，我将为你讲述 Jimmy Cox 的故事。

sentences.en: You won't find any books, podcasts, or movies about Jimmy.
sentences.zh: 你找不到任何关于 Jimmy 的书籍、播客或电影。

sentences.en: His story has never been told, at least not in that way.
sentences.zh: 他的故事从未被讲述过，至少不是以那种方式。

sentences.en: I met Jimmy during the making of Gone South Season 2 about the Dixie Mafia,
sentences.zh: 我在制作《南方往事》第二季关于“迪克西黑手党”（Dixie Mafia）时遇到了 Jimmy，

sentences.en: a loose-knit group of criminals who roamed the South in the 60s and 70s.
sentences.zh: 那是一个在 60 和 70 年代活跃于南方的松散犯罪组织。

sentences.en: If you listened to that season, you probably remember a guy named Kirksey Nix Jr.
sentences.zh: 如果你听过那一季，你可能还记得一个叫 Kirksey Nix Jr. 的人。

sentences.en: Unlike Jimmy, Kirksey is an infamous criminal.
sentences.zh: 和 Jimmy 不同，Kirksey 是个臭名昭著的罪犯。

sentences.en: Some people believe he was the leader of the Dixie Mafia,
sentences.zh: 有些人认为他是迪克西黑手党的头目，
尽管柯克西对此有异议。

sentences.en: He's been locked up for over 50 years.
When we were making that season, I had trouble getting in touch with Kirksey.
sentences.zh: 制作那一季节目时，我很难联系上柯克西。

sentences.en: For months, my letters to him went unanswered.
sentences.zh: 几个月来，我写给他的信都石沉大海。

sentences.en: Then I got an email from a guy named Jimmy Cox.
sentences.zh: 后来我收到了一封来自吉米·考克斯的邮件。

sentences.en: Jimmy said he was a close friend of Kirksey's,
sentences.zh: 吉米说他是柯克西的挚友，

sentences.en: dating back to the mid-70s when they'd served time at Angola together.
sentences.zh: 两人早在70年代中期就一起在安哥拉监狱服过刑。

sentences.en: He told me Kirksey would be willing to speak with me if I spoke with Jimmy firSt.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，如果我先跟他谈谈，柯克西就愿意接受我的采访。

sentences.en: A week later, I was talking with Kirksey Nix.
sentences.zh: 一周后，我就和柯克西·尼克斯通上了话。

sentences.en: Jimmy made only a small appearance in Season 2 of our show,
sentences.zh: 吉米在我们的第二季节目中只露了一小脸，

sentences.en: but I thought his personal story was worth telling.
sentences.zh: 但我认为他个人的故事值得一讲。

sentences.en: I used to be a crime reporter for the Times-Picayune in New Orleans,
sentences.zh: 我曾经是新奥尔良《时代花絮报》的犯罪记者，

sentences.en: and I'd been to Angola before.
It was hard to imagine how someone could escape that place and live to tell the tale.
sentences.zh: 很难想象一个人怎么能从那种地方逃出来并活着讲述这段经历。
我们会讲到那里的，别担心。

sentences.en: But first, I want to tell you a little bit more about the escape artiSt.
sentences.zh: 但首先，我想多讲一点关于这位“逃脱大师”的事。

sentences.en: Jimmy Cox grew up on the north side of Chicago in the 50s and 60s,
sentences.zh: 吉米·考克斯在50和60年代的芝加哥北部长大，
在12个孩子中排行倒数第二。

sentences.en: His father had ties to the Chicago Mafia.
sentences.zh: 他的父亲与芝加哥黑手党有往来。

sentences.en: So did some of his older brothers.
sentences.zh: 他的一些哥哥也是如此。

sentences.en: He started hustling at a young age.
sentences.zh: 他很小的时候就开始干些偷鸡摸狗的勾当了。

sentences.en: When we were little kids, I can remember we used to break into the freight trains,
sentences.zh: 我还记得我们小时候常去撬货运列车，

sentences.en: and one time we broke in one that was full of beer.
sentences.zh: 有一次我们撬开了一节装满啤酒的车厢。

sentences.en: We had beer stashed all over the neighborhood, different places.
sentences.zh: 我们在街区各处藏满了啤酒。

sentences.en: And we didn't drink all of it, you know, but it was just fun to do it.
sentences.zh: 我们并没有把它们全喝掉，你知道的，但那样做很有趣。

sentences.en: We stole a half a train car full of beer.
sentences.zh: 我们偷了半车厢的啤酒。
那时候我们还是小孩子。

sentences.en: I'm talking about 9, 10 years old, probably.
And you've got to figure, I come from the area where you see gangsters walking around,
sentences.zh: 你要知道，我住的地方经常能看到黑帮分子走来走去，

sentences.en: you know, nice clothes, diamond rings, driving nice cars, having nice women.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，穿着考究，戴着钻戒，开着豪车，身边美女如云。

sentences.en: So that's what you aspire to.
sentences.zh: 所以那就是你向往的生活。

sentences.en: When he wasn't robbing freight trains, young Jimmy shined shoes at a local social club where
sentences.zh: 不抢劫货运列车的时候，小吉米会在当地的一家社交俱乐部擦鞋，
他父亲的朋友们常在那里消磨时间。

sentences.en: A bunch of old Italian guys hung out in there and everything.
sentences.zh: 一群意大利老头子都在那儿聚会什么的。

sentences.en: Well, I was allowed to go in and shine the shoes for them.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我被允许进去给他们擦鞋。

sentences.en: One of the gangsters who hung out at the club was a guy named Big Pauly.
sentences.zh: 在俱乐部混迹的黑帮分子中有一个叫“大保利”的家伙。

sentences.en: Well, Big Pauly was the boss.
And he'd sit in his barber's chair, and I'd shine his shoes.
sentences.zh: 他会坐在理发椅上，我就在那儿给他擦鞋。

sentences.en: And when I'd get through, he'd reach in his pocket and pull out his big old roll of money.
sentences.zh: 等我擦完，他会伸手进兜，掏出一大叠钞票。

sentences.en: And whatever bill was on the top, he would hold it over his shoe.
sentences.zh: 他会把最上面那张钞票举到鞋子上方。

sentences.en: And if he could see his reflection, he'd give it to me.
sentences.zh: 如果他能从鞋面上看到自己的倒影，他就会把钱给我。

sentences.en: So I was shining the shit out of those shoes.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时可是拼了命地把那些鞋擦得锃亮。

sentences.en: One day I was down there shining them, and a dude reached over my shoulder.
sentences.zh: 有一天我正在那儿擦鞋，一个家伙从我肩膀上方伸过手来。

sentences.en: I shot Pauly four or five times in the head.
sentences.zh: 我朝保利的脑袋开了四五枪。

sentences.en: The old man hustled me out of there and told me, don't tell nobody nothing.
sentences.zh: 那个老头把我拽了出去，告诉我不准对任何人提起半个字。

sentences.en: I remember I used to keep my shoeshine box in the basement, and they had a big wash tub
sentences.zh: 我记得我以前把擦鞋箱放在地下室，那里有一个大洗衣盆，

sentences.en: And I went down there, and I washed the blood out of my head.
sentences.zh: 我走过去，把头上的血洗干净了。

sentences.en: I mean, there was stuff everywhere.

sentences.zh: 这给我留下了心理创伤。

sentences.en: I ain't too proud to say that.
sentences.zh: 我不觉得承认这一点有什么丢人的。

sentences.en: Jimmy says he never told anyone, including his dad, about what he'd seen.
sentences.zh: 吉米说他从未告诉过任何人，包括他父亲，他所看到的一切。

sentences.en: He figured the guy who shot Pauly must have known him well enough to walk straight into
sentences.zh: 他认为那个枪杀保利的人一定和保利很熟，才能直接走进

sentences.en: So therefore, I felt that I should never trust a soul.
sentences.zh: 所以，我觉得我不该信任任何人。

sentences.en: And it was the catalyst to put me on.
sentences.zh: 这成了我人生转折的催化剂。

sentences.en: If I felt that you were a threat, I was going to eliminate you first, because I wasn't going
sentences.zh: 如果我觉得你是威胁，我会先下手为强，因为我绝不会

sentences.en: Jimmy dropped out of school in sixth grade.
He says he learned to drive by stealing cars.
sentences.zh: 他说他是通过偷车学会开车的。

sentences.en: By his early teens, he developed a reputation as a solid getaway driver.
sentences.zh: 十几岁出头时，他已经成了小有名气的专业逃跑车手。

sentences.en: These guys were going to do a bank job.
They wanted three stolen cars, and they wanted me to place them in certain spots for them,
sentences.zh: 他们需要三辆偷来的车，还要我把车停在指定位置，

sentences.en: And I told them, I'll do the driving.
I was like 14 years old and made $17,500.
sentences.zh: 我当时大概14岁，赚了17500美元。

sentences.en: It was a lot of money back then.
sentences.zh: 在当时那可是一大笔钱。

sentences.en: In the late 60s, when Jimmy was in his early 20s, he moved to Hollywood, where his father
sentences.zh: 60年代末，吉米二十出头时，他搬到了好莱坞，他父亲在那里

sentences.en: ran protection rackets for the local mob.
sentences.zh: 为当地黑帮经营保护费勒索生意。

sentences.en: You know, Chicago people run L.A.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，芝加哥的人掌控着洛杉矶。

sentences.en: Jimmy and his friends did errands and odd jobs for him and his associates.
sentences.zh: 吉米和他的朋友们经常帮他和他手下跑腿干杂活。

sentences.en: One day, my dad told me, said, I want you to take your crew and go bust this Chinese restaurant
sentences.zh: 有一天，我爸跟我说，让我带上我的人去砸一家中餐馆，

sentences.en: up right at lunchtime when it's most busy.
sentences.zh: 就在午餐时间，人最多的时候去。

sentences.en: He said, just pull up front, go on with some baseball bats.
sentences.zh: 他说，直接把车停在门口，带上棒球棍进去。

sentences.en: Don't hurt nobody if you don't have to.
He said, but break shit up.
sentences.zh: 他说，但要把东西都砸了。

sentences.en: Because the dude wasn't wanting to pay his street tax.
sentences.zh: 因为那家伙不想交保护费。

sentences.en: So we jacked a limousine, pulled a limousine right up in front of it.
sentences.zh: 于是我们劫了一辆豪华轿车，直接开到了店门口。

sentences.en: About four of us bailed out of it with baseball bats, went inside, started breaking up tables
sentences.zh: 我们四个人拿着棒球棍冲了进去，开始砸桌子，

sentences.en: and generally causing chaos and scaring the heck out of people.
sentences.zh: 制造混乱，把客人们吓得半死。

sentences.en: And the guy got his mind right and started paying his taxes.
sentences.zh: 那家伙终于开窍了，开始乖乖交保护费。

sentences.en: Before long, Jimmy was an established player in L.A.
sentences.zh: 没过多久，吉米就成了洛杉矶道上的一号人物。

sentences.en: He bought a small nightclub near the corner of La Brea and Sunset and named it The We,
sentences.zh: 他在拉布雷亚大道和日落大道的交汇处买了一家小夜店，取名叫“The We”，

sentences.en: spelled O-U-I, after the adult magazine of the same name.
sentences.zh: 拼写是O-U-I，取自同名的成人杂志。

sentences.en: It was a place where hustlers could come in there at the end of the evening.
sentences.zh: 那是个骗子们在深夜可以去的地方。

sentences.en: I had the cops paid off.
sentences.zh: 我当时已经买通了警察。

sentences.en: You could buy cocaine right there at the table, a little glass vial for a hundred bucks,
sentences.zh: 你可以在桌边直接买到可卡因，一小瓶玻璃管装的只要一百块，

sentences.en: and they'd bring it to you right with your drinks, you know?
sentences.zh: 他们会连同酒水一起给你送过来，懂吗？

sentences.en: And it was a place for hustlers and thugs and gangsters to hang out and be comfortable.
sentences.zh: 那是骗子、暴徒和黑帮分子消遣和放松的地方。

sentences.en: In L.A., Jimmy developed an addiction to heroin and PCP, and he had plenty of run-ins with the law.
sentences.zh: 在洛杉矶，吉米染上了海洛因和PCP的毒瘾，也多次与法律发生冲突。

sentences.en: He was arrested for armed robbery, assault, and car theft, among other things.
sentences.zh: 他因武装抢劫、袭击和偷车等罪名被捕过。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's hard to remember, but, you know, because I'd go to jail sometimes three times in one week.
sentences.zh: 是啊，很难记得清了，因为我有时候一周能进三次局子。

sentences.en: But Jimmy always avoided significant jail time, until 1975, when he was sent to New Orleans to do a job.
sentences.zh: 但吉米一直没坐过太久的牢，直到1975年，他被派往新奥尔良去干一票。

sentences.en: Jimmy told me what happened next.
sentences.zh: 吉米告诉了我接下来发生的事。

sentences.en: It's a harrowing story, but he didn't want to go into it on the record.
sentences.zh: 那是个令人揪心的故事，但他不想在录音记录里谈论细节。

sentences.en: Suffice it to say, the cops tracked him down in L.A.
sentences.zh: 简单来说，警察在洛杉矶找到了他，

sentences.en: and charged him with robbery and two counts of first-degree murder.
sentences.zh: 并指控他犯有抢劫罪和两项一级谋杀罪。

sentences.en: Jimmy's days as a flashy L.A.
He was given two life sentences without the possibility of parole.
sentences.zh: 他被判处两次终身监禁，且不得假释。

sentences.en: And since Jimmy's crimes were committed in New Orleans,
sentences.zh: 由于吉米的罪行是在新奥尔良犯下的，

sentences.en: those life sentences would be served at the Louisiana State Penitentiary.
sentences.zh: 这些终身监禁将在路易斯安那州立监狱服刑。

sentences.en: When Jimmy arrived in Angola in 1976,
it had only recently been dubbed the bloodiest prison in America.
sentences.zh: 那里才刚刚被冠以“美国最血腥监狱”的称号。

sentences.en: He remembers his first day inside.
sentences.zh: 他记得刚进去的第一天。

sentences.en: When I got there and I'm walking to Chow,
sentences.zh: 我刚到那儿，正走去食堂，

sentences.en: I noticed a kind of a little traffic jam down there,
sentences.zh: 发现前面有点交通堵塞，

sentences.en: because it's a long, long walkway you have to walk.
sentences.zh: 因为那是一条很长很长的走廊，你必须走过去。

sentences.en: You have to walk maybe almost a quarter of a mile to the Chow Hall.
sentences.zh: 你得走差不多四分之一英里才能到食堂。

sentences.en: When I got up to where the traffic jam was happening,
sentences.zh: 当我走到堵塞的地方时，

sentences.en: I noticed a dude was laying on the walk, all stabbed up,
sentences.zh: 我注意到一个人躺在过道上，浑身是伤，全是刀口，

sentences.en: and people were just stepping over him.
sentences.zh: 人们就直接从他身上跨过去。

sentences.en: Wasn't paying him no mind, wasn't seeing if he needed, you know,
sentences.zh: 根本没人理会他，也没人看他需不需要，你知道的，

sentences.en: to help if he was dead or what.
sentences.zh: 需不需要帮忙，或者看他是不是死了什么的。

sentences.en: So that set the stage for me right there.
sentences.zh: 所以那一幕直接给我定了调子。

sentences.en: And what did you think when you saw that?
sentences.zh: 那你看到那一幕时是怎么想的？

sentences.en: Oddly enough, it was probably the safest time to be an Angola inmate
sentences.zh: 奇怪的是，那可能是安哥拉监狱100年历史上，
囚犯最安全的一段时期。

sentences.en: 53 prisoners were murdered by other inmates.
sentences.zh: 有53名囚犯被其他囚犯谋杀。

sentences.en: The federal government responded by instituting a series of reforMs.
sentences.zh: 联邦政府对此做出回应，实施了一系列改革。

sentences.en: And besides, he had only one goal in mind when he arrived.
sentences.zh: 再说，他刚到的时候只有一个目标。

sentences.en: Your plan was always to escape, right?
sentences.zh: 你的计划一直都是越狱，对吧？

sentences.en: No human being is supposed to be confined.
sentences.zh: 任何人类都不应该被关起来。

sentences.en: I don't even put my dogs in cages.
sentences.zh: 我连我的狗都不会关进笼子里。

sentences.en: My main focus was on trying to get away,
sentences.zh: 我的主要目标就是想办法逃走，

sentences.en: but we're sitting on an 18,000-acre farm
sentences.zh: 但我们身处一个18000英亩的农场，

sentences.en: surrounded by the Mississippi on one side
sentences.zh: 一边被密西西比河环绕，

sentences.en: and the Tunica Hills and panthers and bears
sentences.zh: 另一边则是图尼卡山，还有美洲豹、熊

sentences.en: and rattlesnakes on the other side.
So I knew I had to do something with a little more finesse to it
sentences.zh: 所以我知道，我必须想出比单纯尝试

sentences.en: than just trying to run through the bushes.
sentences.zh: 钻进灌木丛逃跑更巧妙的办法。

sentences.en: Jimmy knew the stories of other men who tried to escape.
sentences.zh: 吉米知道其他尝试越狱的人的故事。

sentences.en: In 1975, the year before Jimmy showed up,
sentences.zh: 1975年，也就是吉米到达的前一年，

sentences.en: four men escaped after taking a prison guard hostage
sentences.zh: 四名男子劫持了一名狱警作为人质，

sentences.en: and shooting another with a smuggled .22-caliber pistol.
sentences.zh: 并用一把走私进来的.22口径手枪射伤了另一名狱警后逃跑了。

sentences.en: But bloodhounds for the prison's chase team quickly overtook them.
sentences.zh: 但监狱搜捕队的猎犬很快就追上了他们。

sentences.en: Two of the men surrendered and were told to lay on the ground.
sentences.zh: 其中两人投降了，被命令趴在地上。

sentences.en: According to one of the survivors,
a guard executed them both with a submachine gun.
sentences.zh: 一名狱警用冲锋枪将他们两人处决了。

sentences.en: The guard was never charged with a crime.
sentences.zh: 那名警卫从未被指控任何罪行。

sentences.en: Jimmy spent his first four years at Angola
sentences.zh: 吉米在安哥拉监狱的前四年
都在琢磨各种越狱策略。

sentences.en: Then he found one he liked.
sentences.zh: 后来他找到了一个中意的。

sentences.en: One day I was on the yard
and I walked up on these friends of mine talking
sentences.zh: 走近几个正在聊天的好友

sentences.en: and they were talking about this guy
sentences.zh: 他们当时正谈论一个家伙

sentences.en: that had just escaped from Charity Hospital in New Orleans.
sentences.zh: 刚从新奥尔良的慈善医院逃跑了。

sentences.en: And I asked him, I said, well, how the hell he'd do that?
sentences.zh: 我问他们，我说，他到底是怎么做到的？

sentences.en: And they said, well, they don't even hang.
sentences.zh: 他们说，他们甚至都不用吊着。

sentences.en: They just shackle you to the bed and leave, Jimmy.
sentences.zh: 吉米，他们只是把你锁在床上就走了。

sentences.en: I said, well, hell, I'm out of here.
They said, well, he cut his eye.
sentences.zh: 他们说，他把自己的眼睛弄伤了。

sentences.en: So I went and I tried to cut my eye.
sentences.zh: 于是我跑去尝试弄伤自己的眼睛。

sentences.en: I even paid a guy to do it and it didn't work.
sentences.zh: 我甚至花钱雇人来做，但没成功。

sentences.en: So I came back, did a little more research
sentences.zh: 所以我回来又做了一些研究

sentences.en: and I got into the Grey's Anatomy
to see where I could mess with it,
sentences.zh: 看看我能在哪里动手脚

sentences.en: And I got these little medical drops
sentences.zh: 我弄到了一些医用滴眼液

sentences.en: I had a dude stick a needle in it.
sentences.zh: 我让一个家伙往我眼睛里扎了一针。

sentences.en: The first part of Jimmy's plan worked.
sentences.zh: 吉米计划的第一部分成功了。

sentences.en: He was sent to Charity Hospital in New Orleans for treatment.
sentences.zh: 他被送往新奥尔良的慈善医院接受治疗。

sentences.en: He smuggled in a makeshift knife
sentences.zh: 他偷偷带进了一把自制小刀

sentences.en: plus a key to open the handcuffs the guards on duty used.
sentences.zh: 还有一把能打开当值警卫所用手铐的钥匙。

sentences.en: But when he tried to open the cuffs,
sentences.zh: 但当他试图打开手铐时

sentences.en: He asked the guard on duty to loosen the handcuffs,
sentences.zh: 他请求当值警卫松开手铐

sentences.en: claiming they were cutting off his circulation.
sentences.zh: 声称手铐勒得他血液循环不畅。

sentences.en: Then he slipped out of them when the guard left.
sentences.zh: 等警卫离开后，他便溜了出来。

sentences.en: He took his neighbor's dirty clothes out of the hamper,
sentences.zh: 他从洗衣篮里拿出邻床的脏衣服
穿上它们，然后等待时机。

sentences.en: So after I got out of the handcuffs,
I got his clothes and put them on.
I was laying underneath the covers,
fully dressed, a knife in my pocket,
sentences.zh: 穿戴整齐，口袋里揣着刀

sentences.en: But they had this older lady
that was always real nice to me.
And she came by and told me,
says, Jimmy, I hate to see a nice young man
sentences.zh: 她说，吉米，我不忍心看到像你这样

sentences.en: like you locked up like this.
sentences.zh: 好的年轻人被关在这里。

sentences.en: I said, well, you know, mom,
sentences.zh: 我说，好吧，你知道吗，大妈，
我有一种很奇妙的感觉

sentences.en: that I'm not going to be locked up all that longer.
sentences.zh: 觉得我不会再被关太久了。

sentences.en: As soon as she left to go to the other ward,
sentences.zh: 她刚离开去另一个病房，

sentences.en: Jimmy spent the next year and a half on the lamb.
sentences.zh: 吉米在接下来的的一年半里一直在逃亡。

sentences.en: He moved from city to city,
sentences.zh: 他从一个城市搬到另一个城市，
借宿在朋友家，保持低调。

sentences.en: When he got back to L.A.,
he moved in with a woman he dated years earlier.
sentences.zh: 他搬去和一位多年前约会过的女人同住。

sentences.en: He didn't realize the feds had gotten to her firSt.
sentences.zh: 他没意识到联邦探员已经先找上她了。

sentences.en: and they had feds in the house,
up in trees and everything else, I reckon.

sentences.zh: 吉米于1982年回到安哥拉监狱。

sentences.en: And he said, well, well, well,
we got Jimmy Cox back with us.
sentences.zh: 吉米·考克斯又回到我们这儿了。

sentences.en: And I said, yeah, what happened, man?
sentences.zh: 我说，是啊，怎么回事，伙计？

sentences.en: He said, what do you mean, what happened?
sentences.zh: 他说，你什么意思，怎么回事？

sentences.en: I said, you guys are supposed to be protecting me
sentences.zh: 我说，你们不是应该保护我吗，

sentences.en: and two people come in and kidnap me
sentences.zh: 结果有两个人进来，把我从那该死的医院里

sentences.en: And he started laughing, you know?
And he said, well, I'll tell you what,
I'm going to send you someplace
sentences.zh: 我要把你送到一个地方，

sentences.en: but you ain't got to worry about nobody kidnapping you.
And he sent me straight to Camp J.
sentences.zh: 然后他直接把我送到了J营区。

sentences.en: Camp J was the prison's solitary wing,

sentences.zh: 相当于安哥拉监狱的超高度设防区。

sentences.en: It was two years before he was released
back into the prison's general population.
And yet, less than a month later,
Jimmy found himself back at Charity Hospital
sentences.zh: 吉米发现自己又回到了新奥尔良的慈善医院，

sentences.en: in New Orleans with another eye injury.
As he told it, he'd poked himself in the eye
sentences.zh: 据他所说，是他在安哥拉监狱的医护人员换班时，

sentences.en: when Angola's medical staff changed over.

sentences.zh: 他们知道，但我的意思是，

sentences.en: they weren't in with the nuts and bolts
sentences.zh: 他们并不了解之前发生的事情的细节，

sentences.en: of what had happened before, you know?
But this time, the staff at Charity were more vigilant.
sentences.zh: 但这一次，慈善医院的工作人员更加警惕了。

sentences.en: Before, they had guards just come every two or three hours
sentences.zh: 以前，警卫每两三个小时才过来

sentences.en: they started putting what they call a sit-down with you.
sentences.zh: 他们开始实行所谓的“贴身看守”。

sentences.en: That means they have a guard sitting at the bed with you.
sentences.zh: 这意味着有一个警卫坐在你的床边看着你。

sentences.en: Once again, Jimmy had smuggled a knife into the hospital.
sentences.zh: 吉米再次把一把刀偷运进了医院。

sentences.en: At one point, he told the guard he needed a shower,
sentences.zh: 有一次，他告诉警卫他需要洗澡，

sentences.en: And when he went down to take my shackles off my feet,
sentences.zh: 当他弯下腰去解开我脚上的镣铐时，

sentences.en: and I put the knife to his throat and told him,
sentences.zh: 我把刀架在他的喉咙上，告诉他，

sentences.en: I don't want to hurt you, I just want to go home.
sentences.zh: 我不想伤害你，我只想回家。

sentences.en: I really didn't want to hurt the old man, you know?
sentences.zh: 我真的不想伤害那个老头，你知道吗？

sentences.en: He tried to fight, so I wound up stabbing him
sentences.zh: 他试图反抗，所以我最后捅了他

sentences.en: about 13 times, I think they said.
sentences.zh: 大概13刀吧，我想他们是这么说的。

sentences.en: What saved me from killing him,
sentences.zh: 救了我一命，没让他死掉的是，

sentences.en: I hit him one time in the chest,
and I come in for the kill shot,
sentences.zh: 正准备补上致命一击时，

sentences.en: but he had stuck both hands up over where I hit him at,
sentences.zh: 他把双手挡在了我捅的位置上，

sentences.en: and the knife went through both hands,
and it didn't have enough blade to penetrate any vital organ,
sentences.zh: 刀刃不够长，没能伤及任何重要器官，

sentences.en: because I'd have been a dead cracker right now.
sentences.zh: 因为如果他死了，我现在就是个死白人了。

sentences.en: This time, Jimmy jumped out a window onto the fire escape,
sentences.zh: 这一次，吉米跳窗逃到了消防通道上，

sentences.en: then exited the hospital through a side entrance.
sentences.zh: 然后从医院的侧门离开了。

sentences.en: Less than a month later, he said,
he found temporary employment in New York.
sentences.zh: 他在纽约找了一份临时工作。

sentences.en: In August of 84, I was sitting in the Bergen hunting fish club in Queens,
sentences.zh: 84年8月，我坐在皇后区的卑尔根钓鱼俱乐部里，

sentences.en: enjoying a beer with a very infamous person.
sentences.zh: 和一个臭名昭著的人喝着啤酒。

sentences.en: Can you say who that infamous person was?
sentences.zh: 你能说出那个臭名昭著的人是谁吗？

sentences.en: That's Gotti, as in John Gotti,
head of New York's notorious Gambino crime family.
sentences.zh: 纽约臭名昭著的甘比诺犯罪家族的首领。

sentences.en: Jimmy said he worked for John Gotti's crew for a few months
sentences.zh: 吉米说他在约翰·戈蒂的手下干了几个月，

sentences.en: he figured he'd try to hide out in a small town.
But Jimmy wasn't the type to stay cooped up in his house all day.
sentences.zh: 但吉米不是那种整天把自己关在屋里的人。

sentences.en: Yeah, I'm driving a brand new El Dorado
sentences.zh: 没错，我开着一辆崭新的埃尔多拉多，

sentences.en: with New Jersey license plates on it,
and then I had this little hot chick.
sentences.zh: 身边还带着个火辣的小妞。

sentences.en: She's wearing fur coats and shit.
sentences.zh: 她穿着皮草大衣之类的东西。

sentences.en: a nosy agent from the Kentucky Bureau of Investigation
sentences.zh: 肯塔基州调查局的一个爱管闲事的探员

sentences.en: suspected him of robbing a local bank,
sentences.zh: 怀疑他抢劫了一家当地银行，

sentences.en: which he claims he didn't do.
Either way, he came home one day to find himself surrounded again.
sentences.zh: 不管怎样，有一天他回到家，发现自己又被包围了。

sentences.en: They had the state police, the FBI, and all them other idiots.
sentences.zh: 州警、联邦调查局，还有其他那些白痴全来了。

sentences.en: When I seen him, I took off running.
sentences.zh: 我一看到他们，拔腿就跑。

sentences.en: The dude jumped off a balcony and landed on my neck
sentences.zh: 那家伙从阳台上跳下来，压在我的脖子上，

sentences.en: and stuck a little one of them little Mini-14s in my mouth.
sentences.zh: 把一把迷你-14步枪塞进了我的嘴里。

sentences.en: I said, well, get the gun out of my mouth, bitch, and I'll run.
sentences.zh: 我说，好吧，把枪从我嘴里拿开，婊子，我就跑。

sentences.en: He didn't take it out of my mouth, though.
sentences.zh: 但他没把枪从我嘴里拿出来。

sentences.en: At the time, Jimmy was carrying an ID that identified him
sentences.zh: 当时，吉米带着一张身份证，
上面写着詹姆斯·阿洛伊修斯·亚当斯三世。
zh_words: 詹姆斯·阿洛伊修斯·亚当斯

sentences.en: The cops assumed he was just a local gangster.
sentences.zh: 警察以为他只是个当地的混混。

sentences.en: They didn't realize they had a two-time escapee
sentences.zh: 他们没意识到，他们抓到的是一个两次越狱、

sentences.en: serving a life sentence at Angola.
sentences.zh: 在安哥拉监狱服无期徒刑的逃犯。

sentences.en: they made the mistake of taking Jimmy out of the courthouse
sentences.zh: 他们犯了个错，把吉米带出法院时
既没戴手铐也没戴脚镣。

sentences.en: He punched the jailer in the face and ran off.
sentences.zh: 他一拳打在狱警脸上，然后逃跑了。
但在肯塔基州的小镇上，

sentences.en: he was captured after just a few hours.
sentences.zh: 他没过几个小时就被抓住了。

sentences.en: You know, them country towns, man,
sentences.zh: 你知道，那些乡下小镇，伙计，

sentences.en: they was all on me like white on rice.
sentences.zh: 他们对我紧追不舍，就像苍蝇叮臭肉一样。

sentences.en: Jimmy got seven years at the Kentucky State Penitentiary

sentences.zh: 被判在肯塔基州立监狱服刑七年。

sentences.en: Luckily, it was nothing like Angola.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，那里和安哥拉监狱完全不同。

sentences.en: When I went to Angola the first time,
sentences.zh: 我第一次去安哥拉监狱时，

sentences.en: I could write you a note,
put all the money in this bag,
sentences.zh: 把钱都装进这个袋子里，

sentences.en: But I couldn't write a formal letter.
sentences.zh: 但我写不出正式的信件。

sentences.en: While I was in that prison in Kentucky,
sentences.zh: 在肯塔基州那所监狱服刑期间，

sentences.en: I wound up getting a college degree,
sentences.zh: 我最终拿到了大学学位，

sentences.en: and I was working on an addiction counseling degree.
sentences.zh: 当时还在攻读成瘾咨询学位。
吉米遇到了一位监狱心理学家，

sentences.en: who helped him process the trauma

sentences.zh: 特别是大波利的谋杀案。

sentences.en: She was the very first person
that I told that story to.
sentences.zh: 我向其讲述那个故事的人。

sentences.en: you can't gauge your whole life
We had a lot of conversations
sentences.zh: 我们进行了很多次谈话，

sentences.en: and a lot of, you know,
it wasn't something that happened overnight,
sentences.zh: 这不是一夜之间就能解决的，

sentences.en: but it was a major breakthrough for me.
sentences.zh: 但对我来说是一个重大的突破。

sentences.en: It was like kind of shedding a whole lot of weight.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像卸下了沉重的包袱。

sentences.en: A few years into his sentence,
a close friend overdosed on heroin
sentences.zh: 他的一位挚友因海洛因过量死亡，

sentences.en: that he and Jimmy were using together.
sentences.zh: 那是他和吉米一起吸食的毒品。

sentences.en: Jimmy had been using heroin off and on
sentences.zh: 吉米说，他断断续续吸食海洛因
但在那之后不久他就戒了。

sentences.en: I just asked God a simple thing.
sentences.zh: 我只是向神祈求了一件简单的事。

sentences.en: I said, God, I don't know how to pray,
sentences.zh: 我说，神啊，我不知道该怎么祈祷，

sentences.en: to just relieve me of this addiction.
And I started shooting heroin in 66, Jed.
sentences.zh: 我从66年开始注射海洛因，杰德。

sentences.en: That was a long run, you know?
sentences.zh: 那真是一段漫长的岁月，你知道吗？

sentences.en: I have a Louisiana medical marijuana card,
sentences.zh: 我有路易斯安那州的医用大麻卡，

sentences.en: but I haven't touched any real narcotics since then.
sentences.zh: 但从那以后我就没碰过任何真正的毒品了。

sentences.en: Jimmy changed while incarcerated in Kentucky.
sentences.zh: 吉米在肯塔基州服刑期间发生了改变。

sentences.en: He found a purpose in addiction counseling.
sentences.zh: 他在戒毒咨询中找到了人生的目标。

sentences.en: his sentence in Kentucky came to an end.
sentences.zh: 他在肯塔基州的刑期结束了。

sentences.en: Jimmy was shipped back to Angola,
sentences.zh: 吉米被送回了安哥拉监狱，

sentences.en: back to the bloodiest prison in America,
sentences.zh: 回到了美国最血腥的监狱，

sentences.en: where he was due to spend
the remainder of his natural life.
When Jimmy returned to Angola in 1993,
sentences.zh: 当吉米在1993年回到安哥拉时，
他发现这里几乎没什么变化。

sentences.en: The change surprised many of his old pals.
sentences.zh: 这种改变让他的许多老朋友感到惊讶。

sentences.en: I kind of didn't get high anymore.
sentences.zh: 我基本上就不再吸毒了。

sentences.en: A lot of guys were disappointed when I come back,
sentences.zh: 我回来时，很多人都很失望，

sentences.en: I don't mess around no more, buddy.
because my life had taken on a whole different lane,
sentences.zh: 因为我的人生已经走上了一条完全不同的道路，

sentences.en: director Steven Soderbergh shot a scene from his film
sentences.zh: 导演史蒂文·索德伯格在安哥拉监狱内
拍摄了他的电影《战略高手》中的一个场景。

sentences.en: The film follows the story of a charming bank robber,
sentences.zh: 这部电影讲述了一名迷人的银行劫匪的故事，

sentences.en: George Clooney is planning his escape
sentences.zh: 乔治·克鲁尼正在食堂里

sentences.en: with other inmates in the chow hall.
sentences.zh: 与其他囚犯策划他的越狱。
索德伯格希望真正的安哥拉囚犯
安哥拉监狱的典狱长推荐了吉米，
也许是觉得他多次越狱的经历

sentences.en: would bring some realism to it.
Warden Van Oort picked me and told me,
